notes: Design frozen from source optimizer diagnostics and CE/margin mathematical identity, committed in e05bcf47feb46d95e73be99e019f47d724350c7a before current implementation; target scores do not choose configurations.
2 raw-energy objectives x3 seeds. Primary CE_ENERGY. All3 identity9 DELAYCAP_JOINT counterparts are fixed references; no identical controls retrained.

Original identity9 student, optimizer, source L/U, 4 convex style candidates plus clean, same dropout replay and joint cap0.2 are retained. No bidirectional style candidates from the other live experiment.

Only normalization changes to one positive finite frozen source-L RMS per layer; MARGIN_ENERGY uses smooth margin, CE_ENERGY direct unreduced CE with live confidence mixed derivative. No per-sample RMS.

After exactly444 completed identity updates: same12 private AB60 pairs read twice. First24forwards1440L measures raw float64 sumsq/count; second24forwards1440L calibrates own-term gradient coefficient. Total48forwards2880L,0identity updates.
L6300/U56700 hidden TX/V27000 health only. Teachers are two other original E20 seeds, full provenance; students scratch20. No U truth, no V/target fit, no EMA/satellite.

20epoch4440updates;warm444/ramp888;999 independent AB60 Fishr;3996style train/19980candidateeval;fixedfinal20;zero learned auxiliary heads. Scales and coefficients saved explicitly and incompatible/missing state rejected.
Historical teacher model epochs40 + student20 reported separately. All negative results retained; no target-driven reruns.
